stack: TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Router (file-based), oRPC, Drizzle ORM, Better-Auth, TanStack Query, TanStack Form, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Cloudflare Workers (Hono), Neon PostgreSQL (database-per-tenant), Bun runtime, Turborepo monorepo
conventions: Multi-tenant SaaS: controlPanelDb (shared) + tenantDb (per-org Neon branch). RBAC via member.role (admin/staff) + accessibleNodeIds. All client-server calls via oRPC through @/utils/orpc. Drizzle schemas in packages/db, business logic in packages/services, API procedures in packages/api/src/routers (and server-only in apps/server/src/routers). Route files in apps/web/src/routes are thin shells; page UI in apps/web/src/components/pages. Guards from packages/api/src/guards.ts: assertOrgContextMatch, assertTenantContext, guardBranchAccessible, requirePermissionOrpc. useApiMutation hook for write ops. useUserContext for permission checks (not usePermissions).
